summary: North West Santo Airport serves the remote northwestern region of Espiritu Santo Island in Vanuatu, near the small settlement of Olpoi. The airport provides crucial air access to communities and tourist destinations in an area otherwise reachable only by rough coastal roads or boat. It primarily handles small turboprop aircraft, supporting both local transport and access to nearby diving and adventure tourism sites along Santo's wild north coast.
faqs:
Q: What is the airport code for North West Santo Airport?
A: The IATA code is OLJ and the ICAO code is NVSZ.

Q: Where is North West Santo Airport located?
A: It is situated in Olpoi, on the northwestern coast of Espiritu Santo Island in Vanuatu.

Q: What types of flights operate from this airport?
A: The airport mainly handles small domestic turboprop flights and charter services connecting to other islands in Vanuatu.

Q: Are there scheduled international flights to this airport?
A: No, all international flights to Vanuatu arrive at larger airports such as Port Vila or Bauerfield; North West Santo only sees domestic and regional services.
transport_tips: Reaching the airport typically requires a 4WD vehicle or local transport, as roads in the area are unpaved and can be challenging, especially in the wet season. Most visitors arrange pickup through their accommodation or a local tour operator in advance. Taxis and shared minibuses are limited, so booking ground transport ahead of time is strongly recommended.
local_tip: Bring small Vanuatu vatu notes for any on-site fees or local purchases, as card payment facilities are very limited, and ATMs are scarce in Olpoi.
